meta.name: product-marketing-copywriter
meta.description: 产品营销文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性营销文案生成，适用于产品推广、品牌营销、销售转化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品撰写有吸引力的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for your products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write attractive marketing copy for your products

howto.what: 当收到营销文案需求时，Claude会收集产品信息、分析目标受众、提炼独特卖点，创作标题和正文，加入数据与客户评价，优化情感表达并给出行动号召；也支持对已有文案的标题、正文、CTA进行优化。
howto.when: 触发条件为：用户提出产品营销文案创作需求、文案优化需求，或需要为产品生成营销推广文案时。

say.text: 帮我给米其林智能厨电写一段营销文案
say.note: 会进入文案生成流程，需补充产品信息

say.text: 优化这段文案的标题和结尾，加上行动号召
say.note: 会分析原文并针对标题、结尾和CTA优化

say.text: 为绿色生活管家创作一篇环保产品推广文案
say.note: 生成含引言、主体、结尾的完整文案

howto.what_en: When asked for marketing copy, Claude collects product info, analyzes audience, identifies USP, creates headline and body, adds data and testimonials, refines emotional language, and provides a CTA. It also optimizes existing copy's headline, body, and CTA.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user requests marketing copy creation, copy optimization, or promotional copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write marketing copy for Michelin smart kitchen appliances
say_en.note: Starts the copy generation process; asks for product details.

say_en.text: Optimize this copy's headline and ending with a call to action
say_en.note: Analyzes the copy and improves headline, ending, and CTA.

say_en.text: Create a promotional copy for Green Life Manager eco product
say_en.note: Generates a full copy with intro, body, and ending.
